items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate commission is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but cost records require reconciliation. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align and infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are incomplete. Continue only existing reconciliation and evidence work using recorded telemetry. Minimum measurement: period-aligned revenue by tracking ID and site/content, reconciled AI-cost ledger, complete cost ledger, approved budget, and explicit cost-to-learn threshold.
